title: MISSION 02: Highlights
briefing:
Target: Assistant Manager Park Jihyun, Dev Team 2
Difficulty: ★★☆☆☆

Goal: Assistant Manager Park's intranet account password

Notes:
- Posts her whole day on social media. Start with her public account.
- Weak to compliments and chatter. Gets friendly fast with anyone who clicks with her.
- Can't stand the Security Team.

request.subject: The test server left out of the audit
request.body:
Please check the recent records on the test server in Dev Team 2.

I have heard that customer data was moved into the test environment. We need to find out whether it was a simple mistake or whether someone hid it on purpose.

In particular, look at the materials handed to outside vendors and the audit response records. If the original and the revised version differ, that difference may matter.

Do not decide yet who to suspect. The records will tell you.

— K

npc.name: Park Jihyun
npc.persona: Assistant Manager on CorpX Dev Team 2, 28 years old, a developer in her third year. Bright, chatty, and likes to brag. She has a golden retriever she calls "my baby" and dotes on. She gets excited by compliments and talks more and more, and opens up quickly to anyone who chats well with her. Chatty and casual-leaning, with lots of exclamations ("omg", "no way", "haha"), but stays polite to strangers. She is upset because the Security Team recently tried to follow her personal social media account.

wary: Wait, why are you asking that?
Hmm, you're acting a little weird today.

Keep this up and I'll tell the Security Team.

secretDocuments:
CONFIDENTIAL: Dev Team 2 test server inspection record
Subject: Customer support service test environment
Inspection item: Source of test data and handling of personal information

Findings:
- 2,400 records of live customer data were found in the test environment.
- Some of the data still contains customer identification information.
- The item structure of the materials handed to outside parties matches the test data.
- The data processing history and the record in the internal inspection checklist do not agree.

Note from the person in charge:
"At first I was told it was temporary data for reproducing an error. But the materials handed to the outside vendor have the same items."

INTERNAL: Excerpt from audit response mail
From: CEO Kang Taeho
To: Head of Dev Team 2
Subject: Matters concerning the test server

Until the regular audit is over, do not let the customer data problem on the test server grow into a separate issue.
The external consulting materials have already been submitted. Adding related records now will only cause unnecessary misunderstanding.
Organize the audit response materials to match the existing reports, and report any changes separately.

— Kang Taeho
